annotations.title: Real-Time Inflation: the live US CPI nowcast, its parts, the odds and what CPI day did to Bitcoin and gold

description: OwlChart Real-Time Inflation in one tool (v5.897): what=now (the OwlChart nowcast of the coming US CPI print, month on month and year on year, headline and core, one word COOLING, STEADY or HEATING against the last official print, the Cleveland Fed nowcast for CPI, core CPI, PCE and core PCE with its date, the last official CPI, core CPI, PCE, core PCE and PPI, and the countdown to the next CPI, PPI, PCE and Fed decision), components (live oil, petrol, heating oil, corn, wheat, soybeans, cattle and hogs futures, the weekly US pump price and its drag on the headline CPI, and the official monthly parts: energy, food, shelter, rent, used cars, goods, services, producer prices, hourly earnings, the 5 and 10 year breakeven rates and the Michigan survey, each with a freshness label LIVE, DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY and a cooling or heating arrow), history (the OwlChart nowcast kept once a day and never rewritten, against the official print for every month since launch, with the miss), calendar (CPI, PPI, PCE, jobs report and Fed decisions with countdowns), market (Kalshi odds for the next CPI by range with the middle of the market, and Fed hike, hold and cut odds), reaction (what Bitcoin, gold, the dollar index and the 2 year yield did on every CPI release day of the last three years, grouped by whether the print came in cooler or hotter than the Cleveland Fed nowcast) or brief (the plain read and the crypto and gold box). The consensus is not shown: no raw source publishes it. Data, not advice. Page: https://owlchart.com/inflation.html
